//: The perf harness runs against the repo's own database layer, not a copy of its SQL.
The db modules and errors.ts are compiled to scripts/perf/.build with `tsc`, because
plain `node` cannot import a .ts file that its neighbours address as `./x.js`. tsc is
already a devDependency and adds nothing to install; the alternative was a second
implementation of the queries, which would measure code that ships nowhere.
